concept: SQS FIFO: ordering and exactly-once processing
tests: Choosing a service to buffer bursts with guaranteed strict ordering and exactly-once processing.
expected: SQS FIFO queue — ordering (within a message group) and exactly-once via deduplication (5-minute window), buffers peaks. Triggers: "exactly once", "in order", "decouple", "surge".
why_not: SQS standard and SNS standard — at-least-once, duplicates possible, no ordering; Kinesis — ordering only within a shard, for streaming analytics.
